scope: Aggregate RBAC membership counts only; no names, ids, phones or financial amounts
query: select p.role::text profile_role,s.active,('finance'=any(s.perms)) delegated_finance,count(*) accounts from public.staff_members s join public.profiles p on p.id=s.user_id group by p.role,s.active,('finance'=any(s.perms)) order by profile_role,s.active,delegated_finance;
